## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the evidence that supports it.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass.
- [ ] Lint, typecheck, and build pass when applicable.
- [ ] Provider fixtures are synthetic and contain no user data.
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, transcripts, databases, logs, private measurements, or
      internal planning material.
- [ ] Documentation and reducer/schema versions are updated when their contracts changed.
